features.desc: Focus on the act of recording itself, while Chaerok's intelligent engine automates the rest.

f1.title: Rapid Capture
f1.desc: Record instantly, anytime. Safely store inspiration in any form—text, images, voice—without missing a beat.

f2.title: Intelligent Summary
f2.desc: Find the core within vast information. The AI agent transforms complex notes into intuitive briefings.

f3.title: Semantic Connection
f3.desc: Different thoughts meet to create new insights. The ontology-based graph UI visualizes the links between your ideas.

ontology.desc: Chaerok manages records not as a linear list, but as an organic web. As your thoughts grow, the knowledge graph becomes denser, suggesting new ideas you hadn't discovered before.

privacy.title: Your Data is Yours
privacy.desc: Because it holds your most intimate thoughts, we designed it with privacy as our top priority.

f1.title: On-Device AI
f1.desc: Data summarization and analysis are processed safely on your device, not the cloud.

f2.title: Seamless Sync
f2.desc: Synchronized in real-time across mobile, tablet, and desktop for an uninterrupted recording environment.

f3.title: E2E Encryption
f3.desc: All synchronized data is strictly protected with End-to-End Encryption.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Can I use it for free?
faq.a1: Chaerok provides basic recording and syncing features for free forever. Advanced features like AI briefings and semantic ontology are available through premium plans.
faq.q2: Can I backup or export my data?
faq.a2: Yes, you can bulk export all your written data in Markdown and CSV formats at any time.
faq.q3: Do you support languages other than Korean?
faq.a3: Currently, we fully support semantic analysis for Korean and English records, and we plan to gradually expand supported languages.
